title: How do I disable font antialiasing?

posts.author: kosmos_v2
posts.body: Exactly what the title says. I don't like the look of the smoothed font, is there any way to turn it off? Either with a script or some other method?

posts.author: JorgeMaker
posts.body:
The easiest solution I know of to completely eliminate antialiasing in RGSS is to use bitmap fonts.
A decade ago Victor Sant wrote a script specifically for VXAce that addresses this:
Victor Engine - SFont
Unfortunately, it won't work out of the box on XP, but if you have some experience with RGSS, you should be able to make it compatible, or even create something from scratch using it as inspiration.
